limits: Provider historical beta, not independently estimated forward beta.
10% debt cost selected with reference to existing2030 notes coupon, not verified current marginal yield or contractual rate on all notes.
After-full-rent model excludes lease liabilities from debt weights and equity bridge because recurring cash rents already reduce FCFF.
ERP and risk-free source dates differ; ERP own reference rate disclosed separately.
11% is selected risk allowance, not rounding of WACC proxy.
Capital weight uses cover shares/current close and dated notes, not exact current debt/capital.
